resources.string: Roll the die and race your four pieces around the board to the center. You need a 6 to bring a piece out. Land on a rival piece to send it back home. Get all four pieces to the center first to win.
Star squares are safe, a 6 gives another roll, and three 6s in a row lose the turn.
No safe squares: any piece can be captured. A 6 still gives another roll.
Your pieces in the center: %1$d of 4
You rolled %1$d: tap a highlighted piece
You rolled %1$d: no piece can move
Three 6s in a row: the turn is lost
All four of your pieces reached the center!
%1$s got all four pieces to the center first.
